question_fa: برای survey محل کار missingness فیلدهای policy رو چک کن.
sql: SELECT 'benefits' AS column_name,ROUND(100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN benefits IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/COUNT(*),2) AS missing_pct FROM workplace_mental_health_survey UNION ALL SELECT 'care_options',ROUND(100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN care_options IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/COUNT(*),2) FROM workplace_mental_health_survey UNION ALL SELECT 'wellness_program',ROUND(100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN wellness_program IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/COUNT(*),2) FROM workplace_mental_health_survey UNION ALL SELECT 'seek_help',ROUND(100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN seek_help IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/COUNT(*),2) FROM workplace_mental_health_survey UNION ALL SELECT 'anonymity',ROUND(100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN anonymity IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/COUNT(*),2) FROM workplace_mental_health_survey;

question_fa: در دیتاست عمومی، افراد را به دهک‌های افسردگی تقسیم کن و بهره‌وری و حمایت اجتماعی هر دهک را بده.
sql: WITH deciles AS (SELECT *, NTILE(10) OVER (ORDER BY depression_score) AS depression_decile FROM mental_health_general) SELECT depression_decile, COUNT(*) AS total, ROUND(AVG(depression_score), 2) AS avg_depression_score, ROUND(AVG(anxiety_score), 2) AS avg_anxiety_score, ROUND(AVG(productivity_score), 2) AS avg_productivity_score, ROUND(AVG(social_support_score), 2) AS avg_social_support_score FROM deciles GROUP BY depression_decile ORDER BY depression_decile;

question_fa: داشبورد اولویت مداخله دانشجویان افسردگی بر اساس سابقه خانوادگی را بساز.
sql: WITH grouped AS (SELECT family_history_mental_illness, COUNT(*) AS total, 100.0 * SUM(depression_flag) / COUNT(*) AS depression_rate_pct, 100.0 * SUM(suicidal_thoughts) / COUNT(*) AS suicidal_rate_pct, AVG(academic_pressure) AS avg_academic_pressure, AVG(cgpa_10) AS avg_cgpa FROM student_depression GROUP BY family_history_mental_illness), scored AS (SELECT *, depression_rate_pct * 0.40 + suicidal_rate_pct * 0.35 + avg_academic_pressure * 10 * 0.25 AS intervention_priority_score FROM grouped) SELECT family_history_mental_illness, total, ROUND(depression_rate_pct, 2) AS depression_rate_pct, ROUND(suicidal_rate_pct, 2) AS suicidal_rate_pct, ROUND(avg_academic_pressure, 2) AS avg_academic_pressure, ROUND(avg_cgpa, 2) AS avg_cgpa_10, ROUND(intervention_priority_score, 2) AS intervention_priority_score, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY intervention_priority_score DESC) AS priority_rank FROM scored ORDER BY priority_rank;

question_fa: در دانشجویان افسردگی، ماتریس استرس مالی و فشار تحصیلی را از نظر نرخ افسردگی بساز.
sql: WITH binned AS (SELECT CASE WHEN financial_stress IS NULL THEN 'Unknown' WHEN financial_stress < 4 THEN '<4' WHEN financial_stress < 6 THEN '4-6' WHEN financial_stress < 8 THEN '6-8' ELSE '8+' END AS x_bucket, CASE WHEN academic_pressure IS NULL THEN 'Unknown' WHEN academic_pressure < 2 THEN '<2' WHEN academic_pressure < 4 THEN '2-4' ELSE '4+' END AS y_bucket, depression_flag, cgpa_10 FROM student_depression) SELECT x_bucket, y_bucket, COUNT(*) AS total, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(depression_flag) / COUNT(*), 2) AS depression_rate_pct, ROUND(AVG(cgpa_10), 2) AS avg_cgpa_10 FROM binned GROUP BY x_bucket, y_bucket HAVING COUNT(*) >= 20 ORDER BY x_bucket, y_bucket;

question_fa: برای روایت دانشجوها KPI sequence جمعیت، ریسک، عملکرد و فشار بده.
sql: SELECT '1_population' AS story_step,'total_students' AS metric,CAST(COUNT(*) AS REAL) AS value FROM student_depression UNION ALL SELECT '2_risk','depression_rate_pct',ROUND(100.0*SUM(depression_flag)/COUNT(*),2) FROM student_depression UNION ALL SELECT '3_performance','avg_cgpa_10',ROUND(AVG(cgpa_10),2) FROM student_depression UNION ALL SELECT '4_pressure','avg_academic_pressure',ROUND(AVG(academic_pressure),2) FROM student_depression;

question_fa: داشبورد اولویت مداخله دانشجویان افسردگی بر اساس رژیم غذایی را بساز.
sql: WITH grouped AS (SELECT dietary_habits, COUNT(*) AS total, 100.0 * SUM(depression_flag) / COUNT(*) AS depression_rate_pct, 100.0 * SUM(suicidal_thoughts) / COUNT(*) AS suicidal_rate_pct, AVG(academic_pressure) AS avg_academic_pressure, AVG(cgpa_10) AS avg_cgpa FROM student_depression GROUP BY dietary_habits), scored AS (SELECT *, depression_rate_pct * 0.40 + suicidal_rate_pct * 0.35 + avg_academic_pressure * 10 * 0.25 AS intervention_priority_score FROM grouped) SELECT dietary_habits, total, ROUND(depression_rate_pct, 2) AS depression_rate_pct, ROUND(suicidal_rate_pct, 2) AS suicidal_rate_pct, ROUND(avg_academic_pressure, 2) AS avg_academic_pressure, ROUND(avg_cgpa, 2) AS avg_cgpa_10, ROUND(intervention_priority_score, 2) AS intervention_priority_score, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY intervention_priority_score DESC) AS priority_rank FROM scored ORDER BY priority_rank;

question_fa: داشبورد تغییر جهانی bipolar: میانگین، صدک‌های تقریبی و بیشترین تغییر کشورها را بده.
sql: WITH endpoints AS (SELECT country_name, MAX(CASE WHEN year = 1990 THEN prevalence_pct END) AS value_1990, MAX(CASE WHEN year = (SELECT MAX(year) FROM country_prevalence_long) THEN prevalence_pct END) AS value_latest FROM country_prevalence_long WHERE disorder = 'bipolar' AND is_country_like = 1 GROUP BY country_name), changes AS (SELECT country_name, value_1990, value_latest, value_latest - value_1990 AS change_pct_point FROM endpoints WHERE value_1990 IS NOT NULL AND value_latest IS NOT NULL), ranked AS (SELECT *, NTILE(4) OVER (ORDER BY change_pct_point) AS change_quartile FROM changes) SELECT change_quartile, COUNT(*) AS country_count, ROUND(AVG(change_pct_point), 3) AS avg_change, ROUND(MIN(change_pct_point), 3) AS min_change, ROUND(MAX(change_pct_point), 3) AS max_change FROM ranked GROUP BY change_quartile ORDER BY change_quartile;

question_fa: برای هر کشور محیط کار، نرخ درمان‌جویی را با شیوع افسردگی و اضطراب همان کشور در سال ۲۰۱۴ کنار هم بگذار.
sql: WITH treatment AS (SELECT country, survey_year, COUNT(*) AS total, 100.0 * SUM(treatment) / COUNT(*) AS treatment_rate_pct FROM workplace_mental_health_survey WHERE survey_year = 2014 AND country IS NOT NULL GROUP BY country, survey_year HAVING COUNT(*) >= 10), prevalence AS (SELECT country_name, year, MAX(CASE WHEN disorder = 'depression' THEN prevalence_pct END) AS depression_prevalence_pct, MAX(CASE WHEN disorder = 'anxiety' THEN prevalence_pct END) AS anxiety_prevalence_pct FROM country_prevalence_long WHERE year = 2014 GROUP BY country_name, year) SELECT t.country, t.total, ROUND(t.treatment_rate_pct, 2) AS treatment_rate_pct, ROUND(p.depression_prevalence_pct, 2) AS depression_prevalence_pct, ROUND(p.anxiety_prevalence_pct, 2) AS anxiety_prevalence_pct FROM treatment t JOIN prevalence p ON p.country_name = t.country ORDER BY t.treatment_rate_pct DESC;

question_fa: داشبورد تغییر جهانی anxiety: میانگین، صدک‌های تقریبی و بیشترین تغییر کشورها را بده.
sql: WITH endpoints AS (SELECT country_name, MAX(CASE WHEN year = 1990 THEN prevalence_pct END) AS value_1990, MAX(CASE WHEN year = (SELECT MAX(year) FROM country_prevalence_long) THEN prevalence_pct END) AS value_latest FROM country_prevalence_long WHERE disorder = 'anxiety' AND is_country_like = 1 GROUP BY country_name), changes AS (SELECT country_name, value_1990, value_latest, value_latest - value_1990 AS change_pct_point FROM endpoints WHERE value_1990 IS NOT NULL AND value_latest IS NOT NULL), ranked AS (SELECT *, NTILE(4) OVER (ORDER BY change_pct_point) AS change_quartile FROM changes) SELECT change_quartile, COUNT(*) AS country_count, ROUND(AVG(change_pct_point), 3) AS avg_change, ROUND(MIN(change_pct_point), 3) AS min_change, ROUND(MAX(change_pct_point), 3) AS max_change FROM ranked GROUP BY change_quartile ORDER BY change_quartile;

question_fa: کشورها را برای روایت محیط کار بر اساس درمان‌جویی، سابقه خانوادگی و مشاهده پیامد منفی رتبه‌بندی کن.
sql: WITH country_metrics AS (SELECT country, COUNT(*) AS total, 100.0 * SUM(treatment) / COUNT(*) AS treatment_rate_pct, 100.0 * SUM(family_history) / COUNT(*) AS family_history_rate_pct, 100.0 * SUM(obs_consequence) / COUNT(*) AS observed_consequence_rate_pct FROM workplace_mental_health_survey WHERE country IS NOT NULL GROUP BY country HAVING COUNT(*) >= 10), scored AS (SELECT *, treatment_rate_pct * 0.4 + family_history_rate_pct * 0.2 + observed_consequence_rate_pct * 0.4 AS workplace_mental_health_attention_index FROM country_metrics) SELECT country, total, ROUND(treatment_rate_pct, 2) AS treatment_rate_pct, ROUND(family_history_rate_pct, 2) AS family_history_rate_pct, ROUND(observed_consequence_rate_pct, 2) AS observed_consequence_rate_pct, ROUND(workplace_mental_health_attention_index, 2) AS attention_index, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY workplace_mental_health_attention_index DESC) AS attention_rank FROM scored ORDER BY attention_rank;

sql: SELECT 'age' AS column_name,ROUND(100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN age IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/COUNT(*),2) AS missing_pct FROM student_depression UNION ALL SELECT 'cgpa_10',ROUND(100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN cgpa_10 IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/COUNT(*),2) FROM student_depression UNION ALL SELECT 'academic_pressure',ROUND(100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN academic_pressure IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/COUNT(*),2) FROM student_depression UNION ALL SELECT 'sleep_mid_hours',ROUND(100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN sleep_mid_hours IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/COUNT(*),2) FROM student_depression UNION ALL SELECT 'financial_stress',ROUND(100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN financial_stress IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/COUNT(*),2) FROM student_depression;

question_fa: داشبورد سگمنت‌بندی دیتاست عمومی بر اساس جنسیت: سهم ریسک بالا، درمان‌جویی، افسردگی و بهره‌وری را بده.
sql: WITH grouped AS (SELECT gender, COUNT(*) AS total, SUM(CASE WHEN mental_health_risk = 'High' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_risk_count, SUM(seeks_treatment) AS treatment_seekers, AVG(depression_score) AS avg_depression, AVG(anxiety_score) AS avg_anxiety, AVG(productivity_score) AS avg_productivity FROM mental_health_general GROUP BY gender), overall AS (SELECT AVG(productivity_score) AS overall_productivity FROM mental_health_general) SELECT gender, total, high_risk_count, ROUND(100.0 * high_risk_count / total, 2) AS high_risk_rate_pct, ROUND(100.0 * treatment_seekers / total, 2) AS treatment_rate_pct, ROUND(avg_depression, 2) AS avg_depression, ROUND(avg_anxiety, 2) AS avg_anxiety, ROUND(avg_productivity, 2) AS avg_productivity, ROUND(avg_productivity - overall_productivity, 2) AS productivity_gap_vs_overall FROM grouped CROSS JOIN overall ORDER BY high_risk_rate_pct DESC;

question_fa: نمای داستانی دانشجویی: ترکیب منبع، جنسیت و گروه سنی را از نظر افسردگی، عملکرد و سلامت روان مقایسه کن.
sql: WITH base AS (SELECT source_name, CASE WHEN age < 20 THEN '<20' WHEN age < 25 THEN '20-24' WHEN age < 30 THEN '25-29' ELSE '30+' END AS age_group, gender, depression_flag, exam_score, mental_health_rating, cgpa_10, sleep_hours FROM vw_student_dashboard WHERE age IS NOT NULL), grouped AS (SELECT source_name, age_group, gender, COUNT(*) AS total, AVG(depression_flag) AS depression_rate, AVG(exam_score) AS avg_exam_score, AVG(mental_health_rating) AS avg_mental_health_rating, AVG(cgpa_10) AS avg_cgpa_10, AVG(sleep_hours) AS avg_sleep_hours FROM base GROUP BY source_name, age_group, gender) SELECT source_name, age_group, gender, total, ROUND(100.0 * depression_rate, 2) AS depression_rate_pct, ROUND(avg_exam_score, 2) AS avg_exam_score, ROUND(avg_mental_health_rating, 2) AS avg_mental_health_rating, ROUND(avg_cgpa_10, 2) AS avg_cgpa_10, ROUND(avg_sleep_hours, 2) AS avg_sleep_hours FROM grouped ORDER BY source_name, age_group, gender;

question_fa: در محیط کار، ماتریس محرمانگی و راهنمایی کمک‌خواهی را از نظر درمان‌جویی و پیامد منفی بساز.
sql: SELECT anonymity, seek_help, COUNT(*) AS total, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(treatment) / COUNT(*), 2) AS treatment_rate_pct, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(obs_consequence) / COUNT(*), 2) AS observed_consequence_rate_pct FROM workplace_mental_health_survey GROUP BY anonymity, seek_help HAVING COUNT(*) >= 10 ORDER BY treatment_rate_pct DESC;

question_fa: در دیتاست عادت‌های دانشجویی، part_time_job را با میانگین کل نمره امتحان مقایسه کن.
sql: WITH overall AS (SELECT AVG(exam_score) AS overall_avg_exam FROM student_habits_performance), grouped AS (SELECT part_time_job, COUNT(*) AS total, AVG(exam_score) AS avg_exam, AVG(mental_health_rating) AS avg_mental_health FROM student_habits_performance GROUP BY part_time_job) SELECT part_time_job, total, ROUND(avg_exam, 2) AS avg_exam_score, ROUND(overall_avg_exam, 2) AS overall_avg_exam, ROUND(avg_exam - overall_avg_exam, 2) AS exam_gap, ROUND(avg_mental_health, 2) AS avg_mental_health FROM grouped CROSS JOIN overall ORDER BY exam_gap DESC;

question_fa: رژیم‌های غذایی رو بر اساس نرخ افسردگی رتبه‌بندی کن.
sql: WITH s AS (SELECT dietary_habits AS g, COUNT(*) AS n, 100.0*SUM(depression_flag)/COUNT(*) AS val FROM student_depression WHERE dietary_habits IS NOT NULL GROUP BY dietary_habits HAVING COUNT(*)>=1) SELECT g, n, ROUND(val,2) AS depression_rate_pct, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY val DESC) AS rnk FROM s ORDER BY rnk LIMIT 15;

question_fa: آیا CGPA پایین‌تر از میانگین با افسردگی بیشتر همراه است؟
sql: WITH avg_cgpa AS (SELECT AVG(cgpa_10) AS overall_avg_cgpa FROM student_depression WHERE cgpa_10 IS NOT NULL) SELECT CASE WHEN sd.cgpa_10 < a.overall_avg_cgpa THEN 'Below average CGPA' ELSE 'At/above average CGPA' END AS cgpa_group, COUNT(*) AS total, ROUND(AVG(sd.cgpa_10), 2) AS avg_cgpa_10, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(sd.depression_flag) / COUNT(*), 2) AS depression_rate_pct FROM student_depression sd CROSS JOIN avg_cgpa a WHERE sd.cgpa_10 IS NOT NULL GROUP BY cgpa_group ORDER BY depression_rate_pct DESC;

question_fa: کشورها را بر اساس تغییر شیوع anxiety از ۱۹۹۰ تا آخرین سال رتبه‌بندی کن.
sql: WITH endpoints AS (SELECT country_name, MAX(CASE WHEN year = 1990 THEN prevalence_pct END) AS value_1990, MAX(CASE WHEN year = (SELECT MAX(year) FROM country_prevalence_long) THEN prevalence_pct END) AS value_latest FROM country_prevalence_long WHERE disorder = 'anxiety' AND is_country_like = 1 GROUP BY country_name), changes AS (SELECT country_name, value_1990, value_latest, value_latest - value_1990 AS change_pct_point FROM endpoints WHERE value_1990 IS NOT NULL AND value_latest IS NOT NULL) SELECT country_name, ROUND(value_1990, 3) AS value_1990, ROUND(value_latest, 3) AS value_latest, ROUND(change_pct_point, 3) AS change_pct_point, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY change_pct_point DESC) AS increase_rank FROM changes ORDER BY increase_rank LIMIT 25;

question_fa: برای شهرهای با نمونه کافی، فشار تحصیلی رو رتبه‌بندی کن - نسخه 33.

sql: WITH grouped AS (SELECT family_history_mental_illness, COUNT(*) AS total, 100.0 * SUM(depression_flag) / COUNT(*) AS depression_rate_pct, AVG(academic_pressure) AS avg_academic_pressure, AVG(cgpa_10) AS avg_cgpa FROM student_depression GROUP BY family_history_mental_illness) SELECT family_history_mental_illness, total, ROUND(depression_rate_pct, 2) AS depression_rate_pct, ROUND(avg_academic_pressure, 2) AS avg_academic_pressure, ROUND(avg_cgpa, 2) AS avg_cgpa_10, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY depression_rate_pct DESC) AS rank_by_depression_rate FROM grouped ORDER BY rank_by_depression_rate;

sql: WITH overall AS (SELECT AVG(exam_score) AS overall_avg_exam FROM student_habits_performance), grouped AS (SELECT internet_quality, COUNT(*) AS total, AVG(exam_score) AS avg_exam, AVG(mental_health_rating) AS avg_mental_health FROM student_habits_performance GROUP BY internet_quality) SELECT internet_quality, total, ROUND(avg_exam, 2) AS avg_exam_score, ROUND(overall_avg_exam, 2) AS overall_avg_exam, ROUND(avg_exam - overall_avg_exam, 2) AS exam_gap, ROUND(avg_mental_health, 2) AS avg_mental_health FROM grouped CROSS JOIN overall ORDER BY exam_gap DESC;

question_fa: وضعیت اشتغال رو از نظر استرس و بهره‌وری رتبه‌بندی کن.
sql: WITH s AS (SELECT employment_status, COUNT(*) AS n, AVG(stress_level) AS avg_stress, AVG(productivity_score) AS avg_prod FROM mental_health_general GROUP BY employment_status) SELECT employment_status, n, ROUND(avg_stress,2) AS avg_stress, ROUND(avg_prod,2) AS avg_productivity, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY avg_stress DESC) AS stress_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY avg_prod DESC) AS productivity_rank FROM s ORDER BY stress_rank;
storytelling_hint_fa: این query برای سنجش توان مدل در CTE/window/subquery مناسب است.

question_fa: برای شهرهای با نمونه کافی، فشار تحصیلی رو رتبه‌بندی کن - نسخه 31.
sql: WITH s AS (SELECT city, COUNT(*) AS n, AVG(cgpa_10) AS avg_cgpa, AVG(academic_pressure) AS avg_pressure FROM student_depression WHERE city IS NOT NULL GROUP BY city HAVING COUNT(*)>=710) SELECT city, n, ROUND(avg_cgpa,2) AS avg_cgpa, ROUND(avg_pressure,2) AS avg_pressure, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY avg_pressure DESC) AS pressure_rank FROM s ORDER BY pressure_rank LIMIT 12;

question_fa: روند شیوع افسردگی، اضطراب و اختلال دوقطبی در Canada را در طول زمان مقایسه کن.
sql: SELECT year, ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN disorder = 'depression' THEN prevalence_pct END), 3) AS depression_pct, ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN disorder = 'anxiety' THEN prevalence_pct END), 3) AS anxiety_pct, ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN disorder = 'bipolar' THEN prevalence_pct END), 3) AS bipolar_pct FROM country_prevalence_long WHERE country_name = 'Canada' GROUP BY year ORDER BY year;

question_fa: رابطه سلامت روان و عملکرد تحصیلی را در دیتاست عادت‌ها با چارک نمره امتحان نشان بده.
sql: WITH ranked AS (SELECT *, NTILE(4) OVER (ORDER BY exam_score) AS exam_quartile FROM student_habits_performance) SELECT exam_quartile, COUNT(*) AS total, ROUND(AVG(exam_score), 2) AS avg_exam_score, ROUND(AVG(mental_health_rating), 2) AS avg_mental_health_rating, ROUND(AVG(sleep_hours), 2) AS avg_sleep_hours, ROUND(AVG(study_hours_per_day), 2) AS avg_study_hours FROM ranked GROUP BY exam_quartile ORDER BY exam_quartile;

question_fa: روند شیوع افسردگی، اضطراب و اختلال دوقطبی در Germany را در طول زمان مقایسه کن.
sql: SELECT year, ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN disorder = 'depression' THEN prevalence_pct END), 3) AS depression_pct, ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN disorder = 'anxiety' THEN prevalence_pct END), 3) AS anxiety_pct, ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN disorder = 'bipolar' THEN prevalence_pct END), 3) AS bipolar_pct FROM country_prevalence_long WHERE country_name = 'Germany' GROUP BY year ORDER BY year;

question_fa: روند شیوع افسردگی، اضطراب و اختلال دوقطبی در United Kingdom را در طول زمان مقایسه کن.
sql: SELECT year, ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN disorder = 'depression' THEN prevalence_pct END), 3) AS depression_pct, ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN disorder = 'anxiety' THEN prevalence_pct END), 3) AS anxiety_pct, ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN disorder = 'bipolar' THEN prevalence_pct END), 3) AS bipolar_pct FROM country_prevalence_long WHERE country_name = 'United Kingdom' GROUP BY year ORDER BY year;

question_fa: روند شیوع افسردگی ایران در طول زمان چگونه است؟
sql: SELECT year, ROUND(prevalence_pct, 3) AS depression_pct FROM country_prevalence_long WHERE country_name = 'Iran' AND disorder = 'depression' ORDER BY year;

question_fa: کشورهایی که در آخرین سال، بیشترین شیوع افسردگی را دارند کدام‌اند؟
sql: SELECT country_name, year, ROUND(prevalence_pct, 3) AS depression_pct FROM country_prevalence_long WHERE disorder = 'depression' AND is_country_like = 1 AND year = (SELECT MAX(year) FROM country_prevalence_long) ORDER BY prevalence_pct DESC LIMIT 15;

question_fa: میانگین افسردگی و بهره‌وری دیتاست عمومی به تفکیک جنسیت چقدر است؟
sql: SELECT gender, COUNT(*) AS total, ROUND(AVG(depression_score), 2) AS avg_depression_score, ROUND(AVG(productivity_score), 2) AS avg_productivity_score FROM mental_health_general GROUP BY gender ORDER BY avg_depression_score DESC;

question_fa: میانگین شیوع جهانی bipolar به تفکیک سال چیست؟
sql: SELECT year, ROUND(AVG(prevalence_pct), 3) AS avg_bipolar_prevalence_pct FROM country_prevalence_long WHERE disorder = 'bipolar' AND is_country_like = 1 GROUP BY year ORDER BY year;

question_fa: آخرین سال، ده کشور با بیشترین افسردگی رو بده.
sql: SELECT country_name, ROUND(prevalence_pct,4) AS depression_pct FROM country_prevalence_long WHERE disorder='depression' AND year=(SELECT MAX(year) FROM country_prevalence_long) ORDER BY prevalence_pct DESC LIMIT 10;
storytelling_hint_fa: برای روند از line و برای رتبه‌بندی از bar استفاده کن.

question_fa: میانگین حضور در کلاس به تفکیک part_time_job چقدر است؟
sql: SELECT part_time_job, COUNT(*) AS total, ROUND(AVG(attendance_percentage), 2) AS avg_attendance_percentage FROM student_habits_performance WHERE part_time_job IS NOT NULL GROUP BY part_time_job ORDER BY avg_attendance_percentage DESC;

question_fa: درمان‌جویی افراد دورکار و غیردورکار در محیط کار را مقایسه کن.
sql: SELECT remote_work, COUNT(*) AS total, SUM(treatment) AS treatment_count, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(treatment) / COUNT(*), 2) AS treatment_rate_pct FROM workplace_mental_health_survey GROUP BY remote_work ORDER BY treatment_rate_pct DESC;

question_fa: آخرین سال، ده کشور با بیشترین اضطراب رو نشون بده.
sql: SELECT country_name, ROUND(prevalence_pct,4) AS anxiety_pct FROM country_prevalence_long WHERE disorder='anxiety' AND year=(SELECT MAX(year) FROM country_prevalence_long) ORDER BY prevalence_pct DESC LIMIT 10;
storytelling_hint_fa: برای روند از line و برای رتبه‌بندی از bar استفاده کن.

question_fa: نرخ افسردگی دانشجویان را همزمان بر اساس رژیم غذایی و دسته خواب مقایسه کن.
sql:
SELECT
    dietary_habits,
    sleep_duration_category,
    COUNT(*) AS total,
    SUM(depression_flag) AS depressed,
    ROUND(100.0 * SUM(depression_flag) / COUNT(*), 2) AS depression_rate_pct
FROM student_depression
GROUP BY dietary_habits, sleep_duration_category
ORDER BY dietary_habits, depression_rate_pct DESC;
storytelling_hint_fa: برای روایت، ترکیب رژیم غذایی و خواب را به‌عنوان دو عامل سبک زندگی کنار هم نشان بده.

question_fa: مقایسه شیوع پنج اختلال در ایران در آخرین سال موجود چگونه است؟
sql: SELECT disorder, ROUND(prevalence_pct, 3) AS prevalence_pct FROM country_prevalence_long WHERE country_name = 'Iran' AND year = (SELECT MAX(year) FROM country_prevalence_long) ORDER BY prevalence_pct DESC;

question_fa: برای افکار خودکشی، نرخ افسردگی هر گروه رو فقط aggregate بده.
sql: SELECT suicidal_thoughts AS group_value, COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(depression_flag) AS positives, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(depression_flag) / COUNT(*), 2) AS rate_pct, ROUND(AVG(cgpa_10),2) AS avg_cgpa_10 FROM student_depression WHERE suicidal_thoughts IS NOT NULL GROUP BY suicidal_thoughts  ORDER BY rate_pct DESC LIMIT 15;
storytelling_hint_fa: نرخ را همراه تعداد نمونه نشان بده تا مقایسه گمراه‌کننده نشود.

question_fa: benefits با treatment گرفتن چه نسبتی داره؟
sql: SELECT benefits AS group_value, COUNT(*) AS n, ROUND(100.0*SUM(treatment)/COUNT(*),2) AS treatment_rate_pct FROM workplace_mental_health_survey WHERE benefits IS NOT NULL GROUP BY benefits  ORDER BY 3 DESC LIMIT 15;
storytelling_hint_fa: برای سیاست سازمانی نرخ‌ها بهتر از تعداد خام هستند.

question_fa: درمان‌جویی محیط کار به تفکیک محرمانگی چقدر است؟
sql: SELECT anonymity, COUNT(*) AS total, SUM(treatment) AS treatment_count, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(treatment) / COUNT(*), 2) AS treatment_rate_pct FROM workplace_mental_health_survey GROUP BY anonymity ORDER BY treatment_rate_pct DESC;

question_fa: رابطه ساعات مطالعه و نمره امتحان را با دسته‌بندی ساعات مطالعه نشان بده.
sql: SELECT CASE WHEN study_hours_per_day < 2 THEN '<2h' WHEN study_hours_per_day < 4 THEN '2-4h' WHEN study_hours_per_day < 6 THEN '4-6h' ELSE '6h+' END AS study_bucket, COUNT(*) AS total, ROUND(AVG(exam_score), 2) AS avg_exam_score, ROUND(AVG(attendance_percentage), 2) AS avg_attendance FROM student_habits_performance GROUP BY study_bucket ORDER BY MIN(study_hours_per_day);

question_fa: کار پاره‌وقت داشتن روی نمره و خواب چه تفاوتی نشون میده؟
sql: SELECT part_time_job AS group_value, COUNT(*) AS n, ROUND(AVG(exam_score),2) AS avg_exam_score, ROUND(AVG(mental_health_rating),2) AS avg_mental_health_rating, ROUND(AVG(sleep_hours),2) AS avg_sleep_hours FROM student_habits_performance GROUP BY part_time_job ORDER BY avg_exam_score DESC;
storytelling_hint_fa: عملکرد و سلامت روان را در یک نمای مقایسه‌ای نشان بده.
